scripts.build: bun run --filter cf-lite build && bun run --filter @cf-lite/react --filter @cf-lite/preact --filter @cf-lite/vue --filter @cf-lite/svelte --filter @cf-lite/solid build
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run --filter cf-lite-demo --filter cf-lite-site --filter cf-lite-site-preact --filter cf-lite-site-solid --filter cf-lite-site-htmx --filter cf-lite-site-gated --filter cf-lite-site-uploads --filter cf-lite-site-routes --filter cf-lite-site-images --filter cf-lite-site-jobs --filter cf-lite-site-forms --filter cf-lite-site-security --filter cf-lite-site-blog --filter cf-lite-site-ai --filter cf-lite-site-isr --filter cf-lite-site-isr-route --filter cf-lite-site-i18n --filter cf-lite-site-islands --filter cf-lite-site-draft --filter cf-lite-site-catchall --filter cf-lite-cms-head --filter cf-lite-site-rsc --filter cf-lite-site-patterns --filter cf-lite-a11y-demo typecheck
scripts.test: bun run build && bun --bun vitest run --exclude '**/*-workerd.test.ts' && node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run storage-workerd webhook-workerd
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/e2e.mjs && node scripts/cache-e2e.mjs && node scripts/run-sites.mjs && node scripts/scaffold-e2e.mjs && node scripts/auth-e2e.mjs && node scripts/middleware-e2e.mjs && node scripts/storage-e2e.mjs && node scripts/route-e2e.mjs && node scripts/images-e2e.mjs && node scripts/jobs-e2e.mjs && node scripts/actions-e2e.mjs && node scripts/routeconf-e2e.mjs && node scripts/security-e2e.mjs && node scripts/realtime-e2e.mjs && node scripts/metadata-e2e.mjs && node scripts/ai-e2e.mjs && node scripts/isr-e2e.mjs && node scripts/isr-route-e2e.mjs && node scripts/dx-e2e.mjs && node scripts/i18n-e2e.mjs && node scripts/draft-e2e.mjs && node scripts/catchall-e2e.mjs && node scripts/cms-head-e2e.mjs && node scripts/rsc-e2e.mjs && node scripts/rsc-isr-e2e.mjs && node scripts/rsc-i18n-draft-e2e.mjs && node scripts/view-transitions-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:browser: bun run build && node scripts/build-sites.mjs && playwright test
scripts.test:browser:all: bun run build && node scripts/build-sites.mjs && PW_BROWSERS=chromium,firefox,webkit playwright test
scripts.test:coverage: bun run build && node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --coverage
scripts.test:dev: bun run build && node scripts/dev-e2e.mjs && node scripts/dev-ui-e2e.mjs && node scripts/dev-middleware-e2e.mjs && node scripts/rsc-dev-e2e.mjs && node scripts/preview-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:workers: bun run build && bun run --filter @cf-lite/testing test && bun run --filter cf-lite-demo test
scripts.test:playwright-pkg: bun run build && bun run --filter @cf-lite/playwright test
